title: School Assembly
description: Five categories by four rows — a longer board for a full assembly slot.

questions.prompt: Which country is home to the kangaroo?
Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
Which continent is the Sahara Desert on?
Which is the largest country in the world by area?
What do bees make?
How many legs does an insect have?
What is the process by which plants make their own food?
What is the hardest natural substance on Earth?
How many minutes are in an hour?
What is half of 150?
What do you call a word that reads the same backwards?
Rearrange the letters of LISTEN to make another common word.
questions.note: Several real words work. Accept any of them.

questions.prompt: How many strings does a standard violin have?
What does a conductor hold to keep time?
How many keys does a standard piano have?
Which Italian word means "gradually getting louder"?
How many players from one team are on the pitch in football?
questions.note: Association football. If you mean a different code, change the question.

questions.prompt: In which sport would you use a shuttlecock?
How many rings are on the Olympic flag?
How often are the Summer Olympic Games usually held?
